title: Low risk
scene: At a quiet lunch table one student discreetly slides a backpack off an empty chair with one hand and gives a nearby student carrying a tray a small friendly nod. Both remain calm, other students continue eating normally in the softly simplified background. This is a small safe helpful action with no big speech, confrontation, spotlight, dramatic rescue, or pointing. Natural attached arms and coherent hair.
alt: A student quietly clears a backpack from an empty lunch chair and nods to a classmate holding a tray while others keep eating.
